== Biography ==

Aunt Em lives at the old Kansas farm together with Uncle Henry. When Dorothy wishes to see the farm, a vision shows Aunt Em there, washing dishes by the kitchen window, and she seems quite well and contented. While trapped as an ornament in the Nome King's palace, Dorothy wonders whether Uncle Henry or Aunt Em will ever learn what has become of her.
